description: OpenFOAM Solver + Local Service + UI Integration — full end-to-end local OpenFOAM-based avalanche solver
constraints: Localhost only — solver service binds to 127.0.0.1:8090
Single job at a time — reject if busy
Schema version required on all input/output (schemaVersion = 1)

userStories.title: Decisions and baselines
userStories.description: As a developer, I need foundational decisions locked down before building anything — solver repo, container base, runtime constraints, and schema version.
acceptanceCriteria: docs/solver/DECISIONS.md exists with: solver repo + pinned commit, OpenFOAM version, container base image
Runtime constraints documented: max domain size, grid resolution, expected runtime ceiling
Input schema version frozen at schemaVersion = 1
docs/solver/SCHEMA.md stub created with version field

userStories.title: Solver container build
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a Docker container that builds OpenFOAM + the avalanche solver and exposes a CLI entrypoint.
acceptanceCriteria: solver/ directory exists with pinned solver repo (commit hash in Dockerfile or submodule)
solver/Dockerfile builds OpenFOAM + solver successfully
solver/entrypoint.sh wraps `avalancheSolver -case /case` with MPI support
Smoke test: `docker build` completes and `docker run` with a trivial case exits 0
solver/README.md documents build and run instructions

userStories.title: Input/output JSON schema
userStories.description: As a developer, I need versioned input and output schemas so the Go service and UI agree on data shape.
acceptanceCriteria: docs/solver/SCHEMA.md defines input JSON: DEM (origin, cellSize, rows, cols, elevation array), releaseCells, startingZone polygon, snow depth + profile, region coeffs, primaryPath
docs/solver/SCHEMA.md defines output JSON: deposition grid, vMax grid, pMax grid, metadata (solver version, runtime, steps)
Both schemas include schemaVersion = 1
docs/solver/sample_input.json is valid against the input schema
docs/solver/sample_output.json is valid against the output schema
Validation rules documented (required fields, value ranges)

userStories.title: Case template and parameter mapping
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a case template that maps our JSON input into OpenFOAM case files so the solver can run.
acceptanceCriteria: solver/case-template/ contains system/* and constant/* OpenFOAM case skeleton
solver/scripts/generate_case.py (or Go equivalent) reads input.json and populates case directory
Friction parameters, entrainment, run time, output fields are correctly mapped
DEM converted to solver's required terrain format
releaseCells converted to initial condition field
generate_case produces a runnable case from docs/solver/sample_input.json

userStories.title: Go solver service (HTTP daemon)
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a local Go HTTP service that accepts solver jobs, manages workspaces, and returns results.
acceptanceCriteria: cmd/solverd/ contains main.go, service binds to 127.0.0.1:8090
POST /jobs accepts input JSON, creates job workspace (input.json, case/, outputs/), returns job ID
GET /jobs/{id} returns job status (queued | running | complete | failed)
GET /jobs/{id}/results returns result.json when complete
DELETE /jobs/{id} cancels a running job
Rejects new job if one is already running (single-job concurrency)
Job workspace cleaned up after result is retrieved or on cancel
Typecheck and tests pass

userStories.title: Docker runner integration
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the Go service to launch the solver container per job with correct volume mounts, MPI args, and log capture.
acceptanceCriteria: internal/jobs/runner.go launches Docker container per job
Job directory mounted as /case in container
Runs `mpirun -np N avalancheSolver -case /case`
Stdout/stderr captured to job workspace logs
Non-zero exit code sets job status to failed with error message
Container removed after run completes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Output conversion to app grid format
userStories.description: As a developer, I need solver output (ASCII/GeoTIFF/NetCDF) converted to Float32 grids matching the app's FlowPyGridResult shape.
acceptanceCriteria: internal/convert/output.go parses solver output files
Converts deposition, vMax, pMax to Float32 arrays
Writes result.json matching FlowPyGridResult shape (deposition, rMax/hMax, zMaxDelta/vMax, pMax grids + metadata)
Handles missing/partial output gracefully
docs/solver/output-format.md documents the mapping
Unit tests with sample solver output pass

userStories.title: UI integration — solver selector and job flow
userStories.description: As a user, I want to choose between the internal Voellmy-2D solver and the local OpenFOAM solver, submit a job, see progress, and view results on the map.
acceptanceCriteria: ControlPanel has solver selector: Internal (Voellmy-2D) | OpenFOAM (Local)
OpenFOAM mode submits job to localhost:8090, shows status (queued/running/complete/failed)
On completion, results load into existing FlowPy overlay (deposition heatmap, velocity, pressure)
Errors displayed clearly in ResultsDisplay
Typecheck passes
Manual browser verification: selector visible, job lifecycle works end-to-end

userStories.title: Benchmark validation and calibration
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to validate solver output against a known benchmark case to confirm correctness.
acceptanceCriteria: One benchmark case from literature selected and documented
Benchmark input prepared and run through the full pipeline
Runout distance within acceptable tolerance of published result
Deposit extent and velocity qualitatively match
Parameter mapping adjusted if initial results diverge significantly
docs/solver/VALIDATION.md documents benchmark, results, and any adjustments
userStories.notes: Bartelt et al. (1999) idealized 2-segment track benchmark. Terminal velocity 15.0 m/s, runout 51 m (3.4 cells). All tolerances met.

userStories.title: UX safety — warnings, timeouts, error handling
userStories.description: As a user, I need clear warnings that the OpenFOAM solver is heavy/slow, and robust timeouts so nothing hangs forever.
acceptanceCriteria: Warning displayed in UI when selecting OpenFOAM mode (heavy computation, may take minutes)
Job timeout configurable, default 5 minutes, kills container on expiry
Clear error messages for: Docker not running, container build missing, timeout, solver crash
Cancel button works during a running job
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Warning banner on OpenFOAM select, SOLVERD_TIMEOUT env (default 300s), error classification for Docker/timeout/image/crash, cancel button with server-side DELETE
